title: Agent Execution Environment
description: Environment variables injected by nano-symphony into an agent process.

SYMPHONY_ISSUE_UUID.description: UUID of the issue being executed. Also used as the default session/cache key.

SYMPHONY_WORKSPACE.description: Absolute path to the agent's working directory.

SYMPHONY_WORKSPACE_MANAGED.description: Whether the workspace was created and is managed by symphony.

SYMPHONY_MCP_URL.description: URL of the nano-symphony MCP endpoint.

SYMPHONY_TOKEN.description: Short-lived token scoped to the current issue.

NANO_CACHE_KEY.description: Optional explicit cache key; falls back to SYMPHONY_ISSUE_UUID.

NANO_SESSION_ID.description: Optional explicit session ID; falls back to SYMPHONY_ISSUE_UUID.

NANO_ORCHESTRATOR_PROFILE.description: Set to 'symphony' when nano-agent detects embedded execution.
